info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Workbench Update API
info.description: The Customer Workbench Update API facilitates the modification of customer-related data in the banking system. This endpoint allows users to patch existing customer records identified by the specified parameter, enabling updates to customer profiles, preferences, or account details. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives and application developers who need to keep customer information current and accurate. By providing a seamless way to manage customer data, this API supports enhanced customer engagement and operational efficiency.

patch.description: This endpoint allows the modification of details for the customer workbench associated with a specific customer ID. It is designed to enable updates to be made efficiently and accurately.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update customer data in the cross-channel customer workbench for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. The body should conform to the specified JSON schema, which details the required and optional fields that can be modified.
